maria (security): Heads up: trivy scan just flagged CVE-2025-1234 in /usr/lib/libcrypto inside runtime-slim:v2.1. Payload: high severity, local privilege escalation path.
ci-bot: Automated scan report: https://scans.internal/redwood/2135678901 - CVE-2025-1234 (HIGH) | package: openssl | fixed in 3.2.1.
raj (platform): Can we hotpatch the running images or do a rebuild? Hotpatch exists upstream but our base repo doesn't carry it. Rebuild minimal rootfs and re-sign seems safer.
teo (eng-infra): Rebuild + re-sign. One operational snag: our automated build pipeline needs KMS access to sign with cosign. If we rotate the KMS key, old signatures can't be verified unless we retain older key versions.
jess (oncall): FYI deploy window tomorrow 02:00-05:00 UTC. For rollout, recommend 5% canary for 30m, automatic rollback on >3 restarts/min or error spikes.
maria (security): Two immediate asks: 1) can the builder service account access KMS decrypt/sign during the pipeline? 2) do we have audit logs on "cosign verify" events? I don't think verify is currently generating a centralized audit event. @teo
teo (eng-infra): Builder SA is 'img-builder@infra', currently has roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. We need to add a narrower role for signing ops if possible. Also we should enable CMEK key versioning and keep previous versions available for verification. Regarding audit: GCP Cloud Audit Logs capture KMS key use but cosign verify is a client op (it does not call KMS for verify when using public key). With cosign using KMS, verify can still be local — need to ensure the verification step in pipeline emits an explicit audit event to our logging pipeline.
raj (platform): I can add a tiny wrapper to the pipeline that does verify -> emit structured audit event to /svc/logs (datadog). Snippet: 
```bash
# verify-and-log.sh
set -e
IMAGE="$1"
KEY_URI="$2"
if cosign verify --key "$KEY_URI" "$IMAGE"; then
  echo '{"event":"image_verify","image":"'$IMAGE'","status":"ok","key":"'$KEY_URI'"}' | curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- https://logs.internal/incidents
  exit 0
else
  echo '{"event":"image_verify","image":"'$IMAGE'","status":"fail"}' | curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- https://logs.internal/incidents
  exit 1
fi
```
raj (platform): Also propose we write the verification result to journalctl on the builder host so on-call can quickly inspect.
teo (eng-infra): For RBAC, I'll open a PR in infra-iam to: 1) grant img-builder kms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign on specific key versions, 2) add a read-only binding for verification that doesn't allow key destruction. We'll also add an entry to the key rotation playbook: "keep prior N key versions for 90 days".
maria (security): Good. Another nit: our image registry currently only logs push/pull metadata. We should add a registry lifecycle hook that records the cosign verification result to the artifact metadata so audits can trace signature->key-version.
jess (oncall): Implementation question: if we keep old key versions for verification, do runtime nodes need access? We should avoid giving runtime pods any KMS decrypt perms. Verification should be performed in the CI/CD pipeline only. Runtime should only get image digest and trusted boolean from registry.
teo (eng-infra): Agree. Runtime nodes get no KMS perms. We'll add a registry webhook that sets a signed=true tag/metadata after pipeline verification. Runtime admission controller will check that metadata.
maria (security): OK action items, I'll file tickets and owners: INFRA-827 (RBAC PR for img-builder) -> @teo, SEC-642 (image rebuild + signed metadata) -> @raj, SRE-724 (canary + rollback policy) -> @jess. Also want a short playbook for incident response if a later key rotation invalidates signatures unintentionally.
ci-bot: Labels added: ["sec:high", "action:rebuild", "priority:P1"]
raj (platform): I'll draft the verify wrapper PR and a small systemd unit to persist logs. Will also include example cosign invocation with KMS URI: 
`cosign sign --kms gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/img/cryptoKeys/cosign-key@1 IMAGE`
maria (security): Thanks. Let's try to get RBAC PR + verify wrapper merged today so we can start a rebuild in the morning. If any blockers ping me or @jess. :thumbsup:
